newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen, foreign firms build grain silos, flour mill.
newsitem.headline: Yemen, foreign firms build grain silos, flour mill.

text.p: Private companies from Britain, Jordan, Qatar and Yemen are building grain silos and flour mills in Yemen at a cost of $100 million, an official source at the industry ministry said on Wednesday.
The corner stone for the project at the city of al-Salief in the province of Hudaidah, 226 km (135 miles) west of the capital Sanaa, was laid on Tuesday, he said.
The silos would have a storage capacity of 150,000 tonnes while the capacity of the mills would be 1,800 tonnes a day, he said. The project would be implemented within 18 months.
The source did not give the names of the companies carrying out the project.
Yemen is the poorest country in the Arabian peninsula and dependent on foot imports.
